decision: HARO-SURFACE-01: a .haro file read by Haro's rules, a .ring file by Ring's

lines.S1: in a .haro file a keyword is lowercase, exactly; any other spelling is a name
lines.S2: in a .ring file a keyword is Ring's, in any case
lines.S3: a symbol keeps its spelling in a .haro file, and is lowered in a .ring file
lines.S4: `:key = value` is refused by name in a .haro file, and Ring's pair in a .ring file
lines.S5: an eval reads by the rules of the program's root file
lines.S6: each loaded file is read by its own rules
lines.S7: haro fmt reads each file by its rules

cases.why: in a .haro file a word in no single case is a name: aNd, oK, oN
in a .haro file a Capital or UPPER keyword is a name too; the lowercase word is the keyword
cases.stdout:
a name
6
null is the keyword

cases.why: in a .ring file the keywords are Ring's in any case: If, See, Ok -- and oK, as Ring reads it
in a .haro file a symbol keeps its spelling
in a .ring file a symbol is lowered, as Ring lowers it
in a .haro file `:key = value` is refused by name
